visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with her hair in a ponytail and wearing a white t-shirt and blue jeans is kneeling on a light-colored wooden floor in a dimly lit room. She is positioned in front of an open black suitcase and a light wood cabinet with yellow accents. She smiles and gestures towards the camera with her hands while introducing her travel essentials. (2) The woman picks up and displays various small travel tools. She shows a pair of small pink scissors and demonstrates cutting a paper tag. Next, she presents a small blue nail clipper and a folding fruit knife with a white handle, holding them close to the lens for better visibility. (3) The scene shifts to household and personal hygiene items. She holds up a white ceramic-like lemon squeezer, then a transparent mesh bag containing a metal spoon and fork. She demonstrates a round wooden hairbrush and a light blue exfoliating scrubbing mitt, sliding the mitt onto her hand and rubbing it against her forearm. (4) The woman introduces skincare and beauty products. She shows a red tube of toothpaste, followed by a bottle of hair mist and a gold tube of sunscreen. She demonstrates the spray bottle by spraying a mist into the air and applies the sunscreen lotion to the back of her hand, rubbing it in. (5) In the final phase, she presents a clear plastic bag filled with various medicine packets. She then holds up a brown, pen-like device called a fascia pen. She demonstrates its use by clicking the top and pressing the tip against her shoulder and face to show a massaging motion.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 出國行李打包!. [Subtitle]: 今天要來跟大家介紹我平常出國一定會帶的10樣東西. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Slogan]: 小剪刀. [Slogan]: 方便剪吊牌!. [Subtitle]: 第一樣呢其實是三個 一個是小剪刀 出國一定要帶這個 隨身小剪刀. (3) [Slogan]: 指甲剪. [Subtitle]: 還有第二個 小的指甲剪. (4) [Slogan]: 折疊水果刀. [Subtitle]: 第三個水果刀 折疊的 在日本一定會買水果來吃 所以一定要有水果刀可以切. (5) [Slogan]: 檸檬榨汁器. [Subtitle]: 還有這個 擠檸檬汁用的 因為我每天早上都要喝檸檬水. (6) [Slogan]: 餐具包. [Subtitle]: 還有這個 我一定會帶自己的餐具包 這裡面就會有湯匙、叉子 然後小的這種吃冰淇淋用的. (7) [Slogan]: 圓梳. [Subtitle]: 自己的梳子. (8) [Slogan]: 搓澡巾. [Subtitle]: 然後我都會用這個 阿珠媽搓澡巾 欸這個真的很好搓 你知道出國全身就是出油出汗很油膩 你就用這個刷洗超乾淨. (9) [Slogan]: 牙膏. [Subtitle]: 我會帶自己的牙膏 我不習慣用飯店的牙膏 所以我牙膏、牙刷都自己帶. (10) [Logo]: myBoostars. [Slogan]: 護髮噴霧. [Subtitle]: 美妝類我最近一定都會帶出國的 就是這兩個 護髮噴霧 它裡面是水霧狀的 像這樣子 因為它很霧 它其實是有含油的成分 可是因為它很霧 所以它不會讓你的頭髮有結塊 味道也是淡淡的清香. (11) [Logo]: ELIXIR. [Slogan]: 防曬妝前乳. [Subtitle]: 另外一支這個是怡麗絲爾的防曬妝前乳 這支是今年三月新出的 就是三月才新出的 它的質地真的是非常水潤 它就有點像是 在擦美容液的感覺 防曬係數也是到50 所以很夠用. (12) [Slogan]: 備用藥包. [Subtitle]: 備用藥包裡面有那種頭痛的啦 或是感冒的啦 然後或是像太田胃散 就是有時候吃東西太油膩不舒服 這個裡面就是我的藥包. (13) [Logo]: Corefit. [Slogan]: 筋膜筆. [Subtitle]: 然後還有一支 我的神奇小法寶 它是專門給你這樣 戳 戳 戳 戳 這是我跟你講 這是小臉用的 但是它的小臉不是叫你去推這裡 不用 你就是戳這裡 戳戳戳戳戳 你的筋膜這邊比較放鬆的話 你這邊比較不會緊繃住 然後它比較可以讓它拉提起來.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a bright, energetic female voice speaking in Mandarin Chinese over a light, upbeat piano BGM. The voice is clear and welcoming. A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the introduction of the first item, setting a rhythmic editing style. (2) As the speaker lists tools like scissors and clippers, recurring 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to mark the appearance of each item. The background piano music maintains a steady, moderate tempo without key changes. (3) The audio track features a short, airy hiss sound similar to a spray bottle being activated, accompanying the visual of the hair mist. The speaker's pitch remains consistently animated and high-arousal. (4) Towards the end, a series of rapid, percussive mechanical clicking sounds are heard, which are real-world incidental noises from the operation of a massage device. The speaker's tone shifts to an instructional and persuasive delivery during this final demonstration.
